text: Under exponential disruptive innovation the information rulemakers need arrives too late for trial and error rulemaking to be effective, regulatory issues grow more complex, and unknown future contingencies in the rulemaking process increase substantially.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Erik P.M. Vermeulen, Venture Capital as Dynamic Regulation of Disruptive Innovation (2016). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2740477

isBasedOn.name: Venture Capital as Dynamic Regulation of Disruptive Innovation

abstract: relevant information for rulemaking is less likely to materialize soon enough for traditional trial-and-error rulemaking to be effective, regulatory issues become increasingly complex, and unknown future contingencies increase substantially in the rulemaking process.
